title: Manx Gaelic Scripture portions (Bible translation of 1748-1775), one verse per line
period: 18th century (1748-1775), Manx Gaelic in its English-based spelling
notes: License stated as 'Public Domain' in the source README at https://github.com/scrollmapper/bible_databases/blob/59b18c5af5845728c275d5b7178ad0d024172b1f/sources/gv/ManxGaelic/README.md (scrollmapper/bible_databases, files from the CrossWire SWORD module ManxGaelic). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 672,663 bytes; one verse per line as '[c:v] text' with '### Book' headings in English (66 short headings, negligible). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'manx') gives 403,709 characters. Portions only (3,313 non-empty verses).
